name: Opt In Percentage All Invalid Escalation
goal: User repeatedly enters invalid percentage input three times, resulting in escalation.
constraints: User only enters invalid values (e.g., '0', 'abc', '13') for percentage.

phases.description: User is presented with the VPF intro and chooses 'PROCEED'.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot displays intro message and user selects 'PROCEED'.

phases.description: Bot fetches and displays employee details for confirmation.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot displays correct employee details and user confirms 'Yes'.
Bot displays opt-in/out options and user selects 'Opt IN'.
Bot displays 'Amount'/'Percentage' options and user selects 'Percentage'.

phases.description: User enters three invalid percentage values.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot re-prompts after each invalid input; after third, bot escalates with the exact escalation message.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
